name: final_openness
description: how far open the drawer ended (0=shut, 1=fully open)

name: openness_gain
description: final minus initial openness (what the opening reward sums to)

name: max_openness
description: peak openness reached at any point in the attempt

name: openness_backslide
description: peak minus final openness (opened then let slide/pushed back)

name: drawer_open_success
description: 1.0 if the handle actually reached the fully-open target

name: time_to_first_open
description: fraction of the episode elapsed before first opening (1.0 = never)

name: final_hand_at_handle
description: how close the hand was to the handle at the end (0..1)

name: cage_gain
description: final minus initial hand-to-handle proximity (what the guidance reward sums to)

name: frac_hand_at_handle
description: fraction of steps the hand dwelt right at the handle

name: mean_action_magnitude
description: average size of the arm's per-step movement command

name: hand_path_length
description: total distance the hand travelled over the attempt (meters)
